sentence.en: Every grain carries someone’s season of work.

set.name: Saath
set.mechanism: Moving forward together: two grains lean forward side by side in the mark, the condensed contemporary sans leans on its verticals, and a cool monsoon green carries one golden grain a step ahead.
set.expression_move: The golden grain a step ahead: motion in an otherwise upright system.
set.differs_by: The category is static and ceremonial; this is the only contemporary, forward-moving mark and the only condensed sans on the shelf.

logo.concept: Two basmati grains stride side by side; the golden one is a step ahead.

rationale.claim: Moving forward together: two grains lean forward side by side in the mark, the condensed contemporary sans leans on its verticals, and a cool monsoon green carries one golden grain a step ahead.

Category shelf (judgement, sites unreachable here): maroon/red + gold foil with monuments and crowns (India Gate, Daawat, Kohinoor, Lal Qilla), purple/navy script (Tilda), leaf-green kraft and badges (24 Mantra, Organic Tattva).
All faces are OFL Google Fonts designed with both Latin and Devanagari, so Hindi lines use the brand's own type rather than a fallback.
